note: Independent re-derivation of every figure published in step1/step1_data.json, run directly against SAP HANA VEDANTA_POC by Maya (Scrum Master) on 2026-11-04 as a second pair of eyes over the Data Steward's step-1 deliverable. Each entry records the value HANA returned. tools/verify_step1_vs_hana.py asserts the committed deliverable against these. Read-only: every query was a SELECT with GROUP BY; nothing in HANA was altered.
verified_by: Maya — Scrum Master, Inventory & Forecasting Cell

movement_totals_in_scope.query: UNION ALL over FACT_MATERIAL_MOVEMENT_PART_001..004, IS_BACKCAST_PERIOD='N', POSTING_DATE 2024-01-01..2025-12-31, joined to DIM_MATERIAL on MATERIAL_TYPE IN ('ZSPR','ZSPN'), GROUP BY MOVEMENT_TYPE

raw.source: FACT_INVENTORY_SNAPSHOT_PART_001..003 WHERE SNAPSHOT_DATE='2025-12-31', joined to DIM_MATERIAL for MATERIAL_TYPE and UNIT_COST_INR

all_plants_rollup.conclusion: ALL_PLANTS is a rollup identical to the sum of the six physical plants. DIM_PLANT.PLANT_TYPE='AGGREGATE' is the machine-readable way to exclude it.

movement_class.raw_recompute_rule: class from DAYS_BETWEEN(last MovType-261 posting date, 2025-12-31): <=90 ACTIVE, <=180 SLOW_MOVING, <=365 NON_MOVING, >365 OBSOLETE; never-issued = NON_MOVING per the brief

third_curated_table_cross_check.disagreement_shape: MATERIAL_PLANT_CLASSIFICATION says NON_MOVING where INVENTORY_CLASSIFICATION says OBSOLETE — exactly the same 1,199 lines, and it agrees with the brief's rule
third_curated_table_cross_check.significance: VEDANTA_POC contains two curated movement-class columns that contradict each other. The dashboard must name which one it reads.

cut_point_hypothesis_test.hypothesis_as_published_in_step1: the curated rule applies an NM/OBSOLETE threshold below 365 days
cut_point_hypothesis_test.test: if a cut-point at some D<365 explained it, no day-value in 181..365 could carry both classes, and the OBSOLETE share would rise with age
cut_point_hypothesis_test.verdict: REFUTED. 152 distinct day-values in the 181-365 band carry BOTH classes, so no threshold on age can separate them. The OBSOLETE share is flat (~29%) across age buckets and across all six plants, and the two groups are statistically indistinguishable on every attribute tested (mean age 292.9 vs 294.7 days, mean trailing-12m demand 5.57 vs 5.54, ABC, XYZ, CRITICALITY, inventory value, zero-demand share). Both groups carry the identical RULE_ID R-CLS-01 / RULE_VERSION 1.1.0. The split is an unexplained ~29% allocation within the band, not a different cut-point.

last_consumption_date_agreement.class_impact: none — all 1,842 sit inside ACTIVE or SLOW_MOVING on both the curated and the raw rule, so no line changes class
last_consumption_date_agreement.significance: The step-1 deliverable states the curated ageing agrees with RAW on 100%. That holds for the 1,195 disputed lines only. Across all 34,717 lines the agreement is 32,875 (94.7%).
